collectedBy: Three Claude research subagents (transport/practical, culture/food/events, health-tourism/business/practical) via WebSearch/WebFetch; shell collector reached 0/15 registry endpoints from this cloud environment.

items.title: Çerkezköy–Kapıkule high-speed rail section opens, extending Türkiye's HSR network to the EU border
items.summary: A 153 km high-speed section from Çerkezköy to Kapıkule (Bulgarian border) opened, with new or rebuilt stations at Babaeski, Lüleburgaz, Büyükkarıştıran, Edirne and Kapıkule; officials project Halkalı–Kapıkule travel falling from 4 hours to 1.5 hours once the full line is complete.

items.title: Çerkezköy–Kapıkule hızlı demiryolu hattında yolcu taşımacılığı başladı
items.summary: Passenger service is running: three high-speed trains each way daily between Çerkezköy and Edirne (about 54 minutes), stopping at Büyükkarıştıran, Lüleburgaz and Babaeski, plus two Halkalı–Uzunköprü regional trains with a transfer at Çerkezköy. The service is operational and bookable.

items.title: Milli hızlı tren ne zaman açılacak, nereden nereye gidecek?
items.summary: The domestically built TÜRASAŞ high-speed train is targeted to enter passenger service in Q1 2027, mainly on the Çerkezköy–Kapıkule line; tests should finish by end-2026. The article also confirms the line opened on 9 Oct 2026 and passenger trains began the next day. The train itself is proposed, not yet in service.

items.title: Istanbul Airport fourth runway: Busiest Airport in Europe Unleashes New Era With €890 Million Runway
items.summary: Erdoğan inaugurated Istanbul Airport's fourth main runway (2,820 m, first east-west runway) on 18 Sep 2026, raising the total to six runways; officials expect shorter taxi and holding times, especially for domestic and eastbound flights.

items.title: 4. pist ile 1 ayda 284 ton yakıt tasarrufu
items.summary: The ministry says Istanbul Airport's new 4th runway, operational since 18 Sep 2026, handled 1,738 departures (about 7.9% of the total) by 15 Oct, saving about 284 tonnes of fuel.

items.title: Istanbul Airport becomes best-connected air hub in world in 2026
items.summary: OAG's Megahubs 2026 ranks Istanbul Airport first for international connectivity (337 destinations). Its CEO says Middle East tensions shifted some traffic to Istanbul but caused cancellations, and the airport cut its 2026 passenger forecast from 90 million to 86 million.

items.title: Heaviest rainfall in 84 years swamps Istanbul
items.summary: Flash floods from the night of 14 Oct killed four people, closed schools for a second day, submerged roads and underpasses and paralysed traffic. Motorcycles were banned and 46 aircraft were prevented from landing at Istanbul's airports.

items.title: Tornado kills four in Antalya as floods hit Istanbul
items.summary: A tornado hit a construction site in Antalya's Kepez on 26 Oct. On 27 Oct, renewed Istanbul flooding stranded vehicles and pushed congestion to 80%; BUDO cancelled 8 sailings, İDO cancelled 3, and Şehir Hatları suspended Moda stops.

items.title: Gulf & Türkiye Flight Alert: 832 Delays & 62 Cancellations
items.summary: Citing FlightAware data for 30 Oct 2026, IST had 152 delays and 5 cancellations and SAW had 171 delays and 5 cancellations. It warns against self-transferring between IST and SAW (about 80 km apart).

items.title: İstanbul'da maraton alarmı! Metrobüs, tramvay ve vapur seferlerine düzenleme
items.summary: For the 1 Nov 2026 Istanbul Marathon, the 15 Temmuz Şehitler Bridge closed 03:00–15:00, metrobus did not run Zincirlikuyu–Söğütlüçeşme, T1 ran only Bağcılar–Beyazıt 07:00–17:00, and some Şehir Hatları sailings were cancelled.

items.title: Ümraniye-Ataşehir-Göztepe metrosunda test sürüşleri başladı
items.summary: Driverless test runs began on the 13 km Ümraniye–Ataşehir–Göztepe metro (M12), which is about 97% complete. Acting İBB mayor Nuri Aslan said it will open to the public on 19 December. It is not yet operational.

items.title: Ümraniye-Ataşehir-Göztepe Metro Hattı için tarih açıklandı: 11 duraklı hat 19 Aralık'ta açılıyor
items.summary: The 11-station, 13 km Asian-side metro line is planned to open for passengers on 19 Dec 2026, and driverless tests are under way.

items.title: İBB'nin yerli tramvayı TRAM34 Aralık sonunda hizmete girecek
items.summary: İBB says 34 domestically designed TRAM34 trams have been built, and the first have arrived in Istanbul. Service entry is targeted for end-December 2026, and the line was not named.

items.title: İstanbul'un raylı sistem ağı 402,6 kilometreye ulaştı
items.summary: İBB reports Istanbul's rail network has grown from 233.8 km in 2019 to 402.6 km, with Metro İstanbul operating 18 lines and 250 stations.

items.title: Marmaray serves 1.6 billion passengers in 13 years
items.summary: Marmaray (Halkalı–Gebze, 76.6 km, 43 stations) has carried 1.6 billion passengers since 2013 and 181 million in the first ten months of 2026. It runs 287 daily services, rising to 297 with late-night weekend runs.

items.title: 29 Ekim'de toplu taşıma ücretsiz mi? Cumhuriyet Bayramı'nda hangi illerde ücretsiz
items.summary: By presidential decision, Marmaray, the Sirkeci–Kazlıçeşme line and the Gayrettepe–Istanbul Airport–Halkalı metro in Istanbul, Başkentray in Ankara and İZBAN in İzmir were free on 29 Oct 2026. Other municipal transit depended on local decisions.

items.title: Bugün toplu taşıma ücretsiz mi? 28-29 Ekim 2026 İETT, metro, metrobüs, Marmaray
items.summary: A Republic Day explainer that says free rides on 29 Oct covered İETT buses, metrobus, ferries, metro and tram as well as the state rail lines. The article is internally inconsistent and cites no official source.

items.title: Turistik Doğu Ekspresi yeni sezonda 70 sefer yapacak
items.summary: The 2026–27 Touristic Eastern Express runs Ankara→Kars from 21 Dec 2026 to 10 Mar 2027 (Mon/Wed/Fri) and Kars→Ankara from 23 Dec to 12 Mar (Wed/Fri/Sun), 70 trips in total, with excursion stops in Erzincan, Erzurum, İliç, Divriği and Sivas. Ticket sales opened 26 Oct.

items.title: Turistik Doğu Ekspresi'nin 2026-2027 kış sezonu sefer tarihleri ve bilet satış günü belli oldu
items.summary: Confirms the 2026–27 season dates (Ankara–Kars from 21 Dec, Kars–Ankara from 23 Dec) and that individual ticket sales begin 26 Oct 2026.

items.title: Doğu Ekspresi biletleri yarın satışta
items.summary: Tickets went on sale 26 Oct 2026 at 13:55 via ebilet.tcddtasimacilik.gov.tr. The trip is about 1,360 km and 33 hours, and two-berth rooms cost roughly 15,000–20,000 TL.

items.title: Turistik Doğu Ekspresi bilet fiyatları 2026-2027
items.summary: Cites one-way fares for a two-person sleeper compartment of 16,500 TL (low season) and 20,000 TL (high season), pending official TCDD confirmation.

items.title: YHT Gar–Esenboğa Havalimanı arası 36 kilometrelik raylı sistemle bağlanacak
items.summary: A 36 km, 12-station rail line will link Ankara YHT station to Esenboğa Airport. Land handover is complete and site mobilisation is under way, with no opening date given. It is proposed or under construction, not operational.

items.title: Ankara-Kayseri arası 1 saat 45 dakikaya düşecek
items.summary: The 142 km Yerköy–Kayseri high-speed line (gateway to Cappadocia and Erciyes) is over 50% complete, and Ankara–Kayseri will take 1h45 once it opens. No date was given, and the line is not operational.

items.title: Ankara-Samsun arası 2,5 saate düşecek
items.summary: Ministry headline on a planned project that would cut Ankara–Samsun travel to 2.5 hours. Only the title and date were seen on the ministry listing. It is a planned project.

items.title: Çeşmeli-Kızkalesi Otoyolu pazartesi günü trafiğe açılıyor
items.summary: The 52 km Çeşmeli–Kızkalesi motorway in Mersin (on the coastal route towards Kızkalesi and Silifke) opened to traffic at 00:01 on 19 Oct 2026. It is tolled, with fees not stated, and cuts peak summer travel from up to 2.5 hours to about 18 minutes.

items.title: Erzurum-Rize arası 4,6 km daha kısalıyor
items.summary: Ministry headline on a road project shortening the Erzurum–Rize route by 4.6 km. Only the title and date were seen.

items.title: Engelli, gazi ve şehit yakınları kimlikle bilet alıp seyahat edebilecek
items.summary: Ministry headline: disabled travellers, veterans and martyrs' relatives can buy tickets and travel using their ID cards. It mainly applies to Turkish residents, and only the title and date were seen.

items.title: Kalkınma Yolu, taşımacılıkta 20 gün kazandıracak
items.summary: Ministry headline on the Iraq Development Road freight corridor, which it says will save 20 days in shipping. It is a freight project, and only the title and date were seen.

items.title: Havayolunda 9 ayda 193,1 milyon yolcu
items.summary: Ministry release: Türkiye's airports handled 193.1 million passengers in January–September 2026. The title and date were seen on the listing, and the figures are corroborated by the Yeni Asır item.

items.title: Hava yolunda 9 ayda 193 milyon yolcu taşındı
items.summary: January–September 2026: 193.2 million passengers (+2.9%). IST had 64.5 million, SAW 37.9 million and Antalya 30.1 million.

items.title: Antalya Havalimanı 9 ayda 30 milyondan fazla yolcuya hizmet verdi
items.summary: Antalya Airport handled 5.04 million passengers in September 2026 (4.35 million international) and 30.1 million in January–September.

items.title: Ege ve Akdeniz'deki havalimanları 41.6 milyon yolcu ağırladı
items.summary: Six Aegean and Mediterranean airports handled 41.6 million passengers from May to September 2026 (29 million international). Antalya alone accounted for 21.2 million international passengers.

items.title: FlyArystan Adds Aktau – Istanbul From late-Oct 2026
items.summary: FlyArystan is launching twice-weekly A320 service between Aktau (Kazakhstan) and Istanbul Airport (IST) from 22 Oct 2026.

items.title: THAI / Turkish Airlines Expands Codeshare From mid-Sep 2026
items.summary: THAI and Turkish Airlines added 21 codeshare routes from mid-September 2026, including 17 Turkish-operated routes from Istanbul to Europe and Cairo, easing Bangkok–Istanbul–Europe connections.

items.title: Turkish Airlines Expands flynas Codeshare in NW26
items.summary: From 25 Oct 2026, Turkish Airlines codeshares on flynas flights Jeddah–Dammam, Riyadh–Dammam, Riyadh–Karachi and Riyadh–Kuwait City.

items.title: THY'nin Sidney uçuşlarında yeni dönem: Singapur üzerinden başladı
items.summary: From 26 Oct 2026, Turkish Airlines routes Istanbul–Sydney via Singapore instead of Kuala Lumpur, five times weekly on A350-900s, and can sell Singapore–Sydney tickets on their own. Both Australian cities are now served via Singapore.

items.title: Turkish Airlines Lifts Lagos Flights to 10 a Week
items.summary: Turkish Airlines will raise Istanbul–Lagos frequency from 7 to 10 weekly from 11 Dec 2026, though the article notes the schedule was not yet visible on the airline's site.

items.title: Pegasus Airlines to launch flights from Istanbul to Bukhara, Andijan and Termez
items.summary: Pegasus will launch Istanbul Sabiha Gökçen–Bukhara (14 Dec 2026), –Andijan (18 Dec 2026) and –Termez (1 Mar 2027).

items.title: Pegasus Airlines considers flights from Istanbul to Karshi and Nukus
items.summary: Per the headline seen in search results, Pegasus is considering further Istanbul–Uzbekistan routes to Karshi and Nukus. These are proposed only, and the page was not opened.

items.title: Pegasus NW26 Kazakhstan Service Increases
items.summary: AeroRoutes reports that Pegasus is increasing Kazakhstan services for the northern winter 2026/27 season. Only the title and date were seen on the tag listing.

items.title: Pegasus Adds Izmir – Scandinavia Routes in NS27
items.summary: AeroRoutes reports that Pegasus plans new İzmir–Scandinavia routes for summer 2027. Only the title and date were seen, and the routes are scheduled, not yet flown.

items.title: AJet Increases Istanbul – Milan Bergamo Flights in NW26
items.summary: AJet is increasing Istanbul–Milan Bergamo frequencies for winter 2026/27. Only the title and date were seen on the tag listing.

items.title: AJet NW26 Ankara – Central Asia Service Increases
items.summary: AJet is increasing Ankara–Central Asia frequencies for winter 2026/27. Only the title and date were seen.

items.title: AJet 1Q27 Kazakhstan Network Additions
items.summary: AJet is adding Kazakhstan routes in Q1 2027. Only the title and date were seen.

items.title: Pegasus Airlines Completes Acquisition of Czech Airlines and Smartwings Group
items.summary: Pegasus announced it completed the acquisition of Czech Airlines and the Smartwings Group, which could bring more Central Europe–Türkiye links. Only the title and date were seen on the press list.

items.title: Information Regarding International Check-in Procedures at Ankara Esenboğa Airport
items.summary: Pegasus posted a notice on international check-in procedures at Ankara Esenboğa. The page itself could not be opened, so the details were not verified.

items.title: Türkiye weighs new rules for foreign booking platforms
items.summary: A bill debated in a parliamentary committee would let foreign platforms such as Booking.com resume domestic hotel sales in Türkiye if they hold a ministry permit and a local representative, with fees capped at 17%. Bookings made from abroad were never blocked.

items.title: Turkey advances permit rules for Booking.com, Expedia and Airbnb
items.summary: The committee approved the bill on 7 Oct 2026. It still needs a full parliamentary vote and would take effect 1 Jan 2027, with two-year permits costing 5 million TL and blocking possible for unpermitted platforms.

items.title: Turkish Lira Hits New Low
items.summary: The lira neared 50 per US dollar, a record low, under a managed depreciation. The central bank cut rates to 36%, and inflation eased to 29.73% in September.

items.title: Kış lastiği zorunluluğu 2026 tarihi
items.summary: Per Minister Uraloğlu, mandatory winter tyres for intercity commercial passenger and freight vehicles apply 15 Nov 2026 to 15 Apr 2027 (earlier than the usual 1 Dec), with a 5,856 TL fine. They are only recommended for private cars, and the text is ambiguous on cars.

items.title: Kış lastiği zorunluluğu 15 Kasım 2026'da başlıyor
items.summary: Confirms the 15 Nov 2026 start for commercial intercity vehicles (buses, minibuses, trucks) and the 5,856 TL fine. Private cars have no nationwide legal requirement.

items.title: Uludağ'a sezonun ilk karı yağdı
items.summary: The season's first snow fell on Uludağ (Bursa) as temperatures dropped to 2°C, partly covering the Hotels Area. No ski-season opening date was announced.

items.title: Başkan Büyükkılıç, Erciyes'te yeni sezon hazırlıklarını yerinde inceledi
items.summary: Kayseri's mayor inspected Erciyes Ski Center's preparations for the 2026–27 season. No opening date or new lifts were announced.

items.title: Nevşehir'de kötü hava balon turlarını yarın da durdurdu
items.summary: Cappadocia hot-air balloon flights did not fly on 28 Oct and were cancelled for 29 Oct by the SHGM Nevşehir coordinator because of the weather.

items.title: Peribacasının çökme nedeni belli oldu: Hayatını kaybedenlerin sayısı 3'e çıktı
items.summary: Rock fell from a fairy chimney near the Göreme Open Air Museum entrance on 29 Oct after heavy rain, killing 3 and injuring 5, including French citizens. A prosecutor's investigation was opened.

items.title: 2027 Michelin Rehberi Türkiye seçkisi 3 Aralık'ta açıklanacak
items.summary: Michelin will reveal its first nationwide 2027 Türkiye selection on Thursday 3 December 2026 at a ceremony at Divan Kuruçeşme, Istanbul. Coverage expands from Istanbul, İzmir, Muğla and Cappadocia to restaurants across Türkiye (Aegean, Mediterranean, Black Sea, Anatolia); specific new cities were not named.

items.title: MICHELIN GUIDE stellt am 3. Dezember 2026 erstmals landesweite Auswahl für Türkiye vor
items.summary: German-language release repeating that the first nationwide Michelin Guide Türkiye selection will be announced on 3 December 2026 (date taken from URL/headline).

items.title: Experts urge Cappadocia closures after heavy rain
items.summary: After a deadly fairy-chimney collapse near Göreme Open Air Museum on 29 Oct, experts urged temporary visitor closures in Cappadocia until ground conditions stabilise. Authorities cordoned off only the area near the museum entrance car park and reported no issues with other formations.

items.title: Fairy chimney collapses in tourism hub Cappadocia
items.summary: A fairy chimney near Göreme Open-Air Museum collapsed after heavy rain on 29 Oct 2026, killing three people and injuring others; visitors were evacuated as a precaution.

items.title: Famous Cappadocia rock formation collapses, killing three tourists
items.summary: International trade coverage of the 29 Oct Göreme fairy-chimney collapse (date from URL; not opened).

items.title: Cappadocia keeps Göreme night visits open until 31 October 2026
items.summary: Göreme Open Air Museum's 2026 night-museum hours were extended to 31 October 2026; no night access confirmed beyond that date.

items.title: Culture Route Festival moves to İzmir
items.summary: İzmir Culture Route Festival ran 24 Oct–1 Nov 2026 with concerts (incl. Republic Day concert 29 Oct), exhibitions at İzmir Culture and Arts Factory, Painting and Sculpture Museum and Alsancak station, opera 'Murad IV' and 'Troy', and events at Çeşme Museum. Note: visitizmir.org listing gives a 26 Oct start.

items.title: Museums and archaeological sites to adopt new visitor system
items.summary: The Culture and Tourism Ministry and Türk Telekom plan a next-generation system at 216 museums and sites by end-2026: smart ticketing, multichannel digital payment, audio guides, AR/VR and 5G. Citizens will be able to use ID cards as Müzekart; impact on foreign visitors and Museum Pass not stated.

items.title: Nobel laureate Aziz Sancar's childhood home opens as museum in Türkiye's Mardin
items.summary: Aziz Sancar's restored childhood home in Savur, Mardin, has opened as a ministry-run museum with three halls of his instruments, diplomas, awards and research documents, plus a planned reading room and science centre.

items.title: Nighttime museum visits exceed 1.3 million
items.summary: Night-museum visits rose 32% to 1,326,590 in 2026, led by Ephesus, Galata Tower and Hierapolis; programme extended at some sites (season now over).

items.title: Filmekimi opens in Istanbul with films by world-renowned directors
items.summary: İKSV's Filmekimi ran in Istanbul 9–18 Oct, Ankara 15–18 Oct and İzmir/Mersin 22–25 Oct 2026 with Cannes/Venice titles (Almodóvar, Farhadi, Herzog, McDonagh). Event is over.

items.title: Istanbul offers packed week of art, music, cultural events
items.summary: Weekly guide: Artweeks Istanbul Collectors edition at Akaretler through 8 Nov; Borusan Contemporary shows through 15 Aug 2027; Şerif Muhiddin Targan exhibition at Beyazıt Manuscript Library through 9 Dec; Akbank Jazz 26 Sep–11 Oct.

items.title: Ankara comes alive as Türkiye Culture Route Festival begins
items.summary: Ankara Culture Route Festival ran 19–27 Sep 2026 with 518 events across 42 venues and an 'Ankara Culinary Destinations' list of 50+ restaurants (useful evergreen food list).

items.title: Frank Bowling, early Istanbul photography meet at Pera Museum
items.summary: Pera Museum shows 'Frank Bowling: Creation and Destruction' (with four Francis Bacon loans) until 31 Jan 2027 and 'The Republic Behind the Scenes' press-photo archive show until 28 Mar 2027.

items.title: What newspapers left out: Pera Museum reveals another side of republican Istanbul
items.summary: Pera Museum's 'The Republic Behind the Scenes' displays unpublished press photographs of early republican Istanbul, running through 28 March 2027.

items.title: Exhibition of 1950–1970 abstract painting from Türkiye opens in Istanbul
items.summary: Kura Kolektif's 'The Most Beautiful Part of the Story: Abstract Painting in Türkiye' shows 74 works by 29 artists from the U+K Art Collection at Muradiye, Karaköy, until 12 Dec 2026.

items.title: Contemporary Istanbul opens 21st edition with 70 galleries, 'Focus: Asia' program
items.summary: Contemporary Istanbul's 21st edition ran 23–27 Sep 2026 at Tersane Istanbul with 70 galleries from 16 countries; Jaume Plensa's 7m 'Juana' stands on the Golden Horn waterfront.

items.title: Istanbul stages and galleries fill up for Oct. 19-25
items.summary: Long-running shows: Ara Güler 'Little Hungary' at Hungarian Cultural Center to 12 Feb 2027; Koç 100th-anniversary show at Rahmi M. Koç Museum to 7 Feb 2027; Arter 'No later. Later is now.' to 28 Mar 2027; Istanbul Modern collection show 'Under/Beneath the Same Blue'.

items.title: Türkiye's Touristic Eastern Express to resume Dec. 21, tickets on sale Oct. 26
items.summary: Touristic Eastern Express runs Ankara–Kars 21 Dec 2026–10 Mar 2027 and Kars–Ankara 23 Dec–12 Mar 2027 (70 trips; Mon/Wed/Fri from Ankara, Wed/Fri/Sun from Kars), with sightseeing stops incl. İliç, Divriği, Sivas, Erzincan, Erzurum; tickets on sale 26 Oct via TCDD Taşımacılık. Two TT articles disagree on which direction gets which stops.

items.title: Winter Eastern Express returns with sleeper cars, sightseeing
items.summary: Transport minister announced 70 Eastern Express tourist trips for winter 2026-27 with sleeping cars (10 two-bed compartments) and dining car; individual ticket sales from 26 Oct.

items.title: Turistik Doğu Ekspresi seferleri için tarih belli oldu! Bilet fiyatları katlandı
items.summary: Kars local paper confirms the 2026-27 Touristic Eastern Express dates and 26 Oct ticket launch; headline says prices have risen sharply but the text gives no figures.

items.title: CNN picks 23 Turkish dishes that go beyond the kebab
items.summary: Gallery of CNN International's list of 23 Turkish dishes beyond kebab, many tied to specific cities and regions.

items.title: Istanbul's 'What Haunts Us' exhibition features 25 artists
items.summary: Group show of 25 artists curated by Uğurcan Kaçmaz at Tariria Culture, Arts and Gastronomy Center in Van, 10 Oct–17 Nov 2026.

items.title: When art, music, artificial intelligence meet at Istanbul's AKM
items.summary: Limak's 50th-anniversary evening at AKM (20 Oct) paired a repurposed-doors exhibition with a concert where an AI-generated conductor led one piece.

items.title: Discover 3 generations, 96 years of visual legacy in Istanbul
items.summary: Erbak family travel-photography exhibition at Akaretler No:5, 26 Sep–11 Oct 2026 (closed).

items.title: Exhibitions open at Zeugma Museum
items.summary: Zeugma Mosaic Museum in Gaziantep hosted four exhibitions (Ottoman Sacred Relics, Living Heritage: Gaziantep, miniature-style ceramics, art education) for the GastroAntep Culture Route Festival; run dates not given.

items.title: Kütahya Archaeology Museum opens with millennia-old artifacts
items.summary: The new Kütahya Archaeology and Mining Museum opened on 30 Sep 2026, combining archaeology, ethnography, tile-making and mining heritage with a children's museum; about 3,300 of 62,701 artefacts are on display, many from Aizanoi and Seyitömer.

items.title: Restoration reveals architectural secrets of Istanbul's Süleymaniye Mosque
items.summary: Restoration at Mimar Sinan's Süleymaniye Mosque uncovered acoustic vessels in the dome, 16th-century paintings and earlier decorative layers; work is intended to defer the next major repair by ~50 years. Visitor access not stated.

items.title: Land, water, clay shape Çanakkale Biennial
items.summary: 10th Çanakkale Biennial 'Metcezir // Ebb & Flow' runs 10 Oct–20 Nov 2026 at 15 venues incl. Troy Museum, Korfmann Library, Adatepe Olive Oil Museum and village sites, with 60+ artists from nine countries.

items.title: Toprak, su ve hafızanın kesiştiği yerde: Metcezir 10. Çanakkale Bienali
items.summary: Review of the 10th Çanakkale Biennial, visitable until 20 November 2026, featuring ceramics, glass, sound and site-specific works across the city.

items.title: 10. Çanakkale Bienali 10 Ekim'de başlıyor: 9 ülkeden 60'tan fazla sanatçı
items.summary: Pre-opening notice for the 10th Çanakkale Biennial (date from search-result timestamp; not opened).

items.title: Legendary Orient Express train arrives in Istanbul
items.summary: Belmond's Venice Simplon-Orient-Express reached Istanbul (Bakırköy) from Paris on its second 2026 journey with 70+ passengers; border checks were moved to Edirne due to Kapıkule works.

items.title: Diyarbakır Culture Route Festival to bring nine days of concerts, food and art
items.summary: Diyarbakır Culture Route Festival ran 10–18 Oct 2026 with free concerts in Nevruz Park and 40+ food stops featuring Michelin-recognised chefs. Over.

items.title: İstanbul Tiyatro Festivali 22 Ekim'de başlıyor: programda 17 gösteri var
items.summary: İKSV's 30th Istanbul Theatre Festival runs 22 Oct–3 Dec 2026 with 17 productions at venues incl. Zorlu PSM, AKM, Arter Karbon, Yeniköy Panayia Church and Leyla Gencer Opera Center. Only one show (17 Nov) is confirmed with English surtitles.

items.title: Aegean castle awaits UNESCO World Heritage listing
items.summary: Güvercinada Castle in Kuşadası, on UNESCO's Tentative List since 2020, is still seeking full status; its restored inner fortress operates as an open-air museum with a maritime trade exhibit.

items.title: Erciyes Kayak Merkezi 2026-2027 sezonu ne zaman açılıyor? Otobüs saatleri belli oldu
items.summary: Erciyes ski centre's 2026-27 opening date is not yet fixed; preparations ongoing and weekend public buses run in ski season.

items.title: Erciyes Kayak Merkezi'ne gidecekler dikkat: 2 Kasım'a kadar hizmete kapatıldı
items.summary: Erciyes Hacılar gondola closed for maintenance 19 Oct–2 Nov 2026; season usually opens last week of November depending on snow (last season opened 18 Dec 2025). 41 slopes, 112 km.

items.title: Hatay'da Gastro Antakya Kültür ve Gastronomi Festivali başladı
items.summary: Gastro Antakya Culture and Gastronomy Festival ran 21–25 Oct 2026 at 15 Temmuz Milli İrade Park, Antakya, promoting the quake-hit city's cuisine with local food stands.

items.title: Ankara'da dünya prömiyeri: Residui sergisi CerModern'de açılıyor
items.summary: Italian Embassy's 'Residui: From Waste to Art' design exhibition has its world premiere at CerModern, Ankara, 16 Oct–8 Nov 2026.

items.title: UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage: 64 practices to be examined
items.summary: The 21st ICH Committee meets 30 Nov–5 Dec 2026 in Xiamen, China, examining nominations 1–3 Dec; Türkiye is part of an eight-country joint nomination for traditional felt making.

items.title: Berksoy's work to join Istanbul Modern collection
items.summary: Semiha Berksoy's 1998 self-portrait 'Ariadne auf Naxos' is being donated to Istanbul Modern as the artist's retrospective nears its 22 November 2026 close.

items.title: Van Gogh Museum's Emilie Gordenker to speak at Istanbul Modern
items.summary: Van Gogh Museum director gave a free talk at Istanbul Modern on 27 Oct 2026 closing the Museums Talk series. Past event.

items.title: Denizli'de müze ve ören yerlerinde kış saati uygulaması başladı
items.summary: Winter hours from 1 Oct 2026: Pamukkale South/North gates 08:00–18:00; Hierapolis Archaeology Museum, Laodikeia and Antique Pool 08:00–17:30; no night-museum visits in winter.

items.title: Antalya'da müze ve ören yeri gezisi yapacaklar şaşırabilir! 1 Kasım'da her şey değişiyor
items.summary: Antalya province museums and sites switch to winter hours 1 Nov 2026–1 May 2027: museums 08:30–17:30; Aspendos, Perge, Phaselis, Olympos, Myra, Patara, Xanthos, Side etc. 08:00–17:00; Termessos ticket office closes 15:30.

items.title: Van'ın tarihi mekânlarında kış saati uygulaması
items.summary: Van winter schedule 1 Oct 2026–1 May 2027: Akdamar Island 08:30–17:30, Van Castle 08:30–17:00; Van Museum and Hoşap Castle temporarily closed to visitors.

items.title: Dolmabahçe Sarayı 29 Ekim ziyaret saatleri 2026
items.summary: Citing Milli Saraylar, Dolmabahçe ticket offices open 09:00–17:00; palace closed on New Year's Day and first days of Ramazan and Kurban Bayramı.

items.title: New Ankara park brings Türkiye's landmarks down to size
items.summary: Beştepe National Forest, a 159-acre Ankara park with ~750,000 trees, a zoo and a 'Civilizations Park' of miniature landmarks (Hagia Sophia, Anıtkabir, Göbeklitepe), is set to open with Turkic States leaders attending; no date or entry info given.

items.title: Restored 190-year-old Greek church in central Türkiye readies for visitors
items.summary: St. Eustathios Church (1836) in İncesu, Kayseri, ~45–50 km from Göreme/Ürgüp, is becoming a city museum; displays over 80% complete, opening 'soon'.

items.title: Şanlıurfa museum preserves centuries-old traditions
items.summary: Şanlıurfa City Museum at Beykapısı, in a ~900-year-old building, displays local crafts, dress, cuisine and family life and draws 25,000–30,000 visitors a year.

items.title: Unproven Noah's Ark site in Türkiye draws $3,600 tours
items.summary: Operators sell luxury tours up to $3,600 to the Durupınar formation near Mount Ağrı although surveys have produced no solid evidence; soil test results are pending.

items.title: Gastro Afyon 2026 için geri sayım
items.summary: 8th International Gastro Afyon festival ran 2–4 Oct 2026 with 160 stands and 53 chefs from 20+ countries, plus a Guinness attempt at the world's largest Anatolian table. Over.

items.title: İstanbul'da 9 gün sürecek Kültür Yolu Festivali başlıyor
items.summary: Istanbul (ex-Beyoğlu) Culture Route Festival ran 26 Sep–4 Oct 2026 with RPO at AKM and 'İstanbul Lezzet Noktaları' food routes in Beyoğlu, Kadıköy-Moda and Beykoz. Over.

items.title: Bursa'da turist rehberlerinden dikkat çeken etkinlikler
items.summary: Bursa guides' association held a seminar on İznik's underwater basilica and study tours; minor news.

items.title: Tourists drawn to Midyat's 3,000-year-old filigree tradition
items.summary: Midyat's telkari silver filigree craft is drawing growing tourist interest; handmade jewellery is a popular souvenir.

items.title: Opera Ballet to take center stage in Anatolian districts
items.summary: Third Anatolian Opera and Ballet Festival from November 2026 brings free performances to Midyat, Divriği, Akhisar and Kadirli.

items.title: Anatolia Opera and Ballet Festival to visit 4 towns in November
items.summary: Same festival: free, all-ages performances in Midyat, Divriği, Akhisar, Kadirli and other towns in November 2026; no per-town dates yet.

items.title: Over 90,000 spectators expected at Türkiye's opera and ballet festivals
items.summary: State Opera and Ballet festival calendar; Denizli Opera and Ballet Days closes 21 Nov with 'Carmen'.

items.title: Turkish literature museum attracts 18,000 visitors in nine months
items.summary: Nilüfer Literature Museum in Misi/Gümüştepe, Bursa, drew 18,000 visitors in Jan–Sep 2026 with exhibits on ~240 Turkish writers.

items.title: Hittite kings' spring retreat set for new excavations
items.summary: Excavations at the 3,500-year-old Hittite city of Sarissa (Sivas) will restart in 2027 after 20+ years under Istanbul University.

items.title: Arter'in yeni sergisi 'Sonra yok. Sonrası şimdi.' ziyarete açıldı
items.summary: Arter collection group show on the end of the world, curated by Delfin Öğütoğulları, opened 8 Oct 2026 in Gallery 3 (runs to 28 Mar 2027 per Türkiye Today).

items.title: Koç Topluluğu'nun 100 yıllık sanayi tarihi Rahmi M. Koç Müzesi'nde
items.summary: 'Domestic Industry, International Reputation' at Rahmi M. Koç Museum's Mustafa V. Koç Building traces Turkish industry since 1926, open until 7 Feb 2027.

items.title: Ottoman sultans' poetry comes alive in calligraphy at Istanbul's Dolmabahçe Palace
items.summary: 'Verses of the Sultanate' (26 works pairing calligraphy with sultans' poems) at Dolmabahçe Palace Art Gallery ran through 1 Nov 2026. Closed.

items.title: After record Q3, Türkiye sees 2026 tourism revenue topping $65B
items.summary: Q3 2026 tourism revenue rose 5% y/y to $25.5bn and nine-month revenue 2.4% to ~$51.3bn; Q3 visitor numbers fell 1% to 23.37m. Minister Ersoy projects full-year revenue above $65bn.

items.title: Türkiye draws 49M visitors, earns record $51.3B through September
items.summary: 49.13m visitors in Jan–Sep 2026 and record $51.28bn revenue; Russia, Germany and the UK are the top source markets.

items.title: Türkiye's Q3 Tourism Revenues Rise 5%, Minister Sees Full-Year Topping $65 Billion
items.summary: Average overnight spend per visitor was $723 in Q3 (-1.3% y/y) and $778 for nine months (-9.6%); the minister warned of risks from the Iran war and drone attacks.

items.title: Bakan Ersoy Açıkladı: 9 Aylık Turizm Geliri Yaklaşık 52 Milyar Dolara Ulaştı
items.summary: Turkish trade-press report of the nine-month 2026 tourism revenue (~$51.28bn) and Q3 revenue of $25.53bn (date seen on listing page).

items.title: Russia, Germany lead foreign arrivals to Türkiye as visitor numbers edge down
items.summary: 34.8m foreign visitors Jan–Aug 2026, down 1.84% y/y; Russia (4.7m) and Germany (4.4m) lead, Istanbul handled 35.8% of arrivals.

items.title: Türkiye targets earning $70B from tourism in 2027
items.summary: The 2027 budget draft raises tourism allocation to $244.5m and sets revenue targets of $70bn (2027), $73.5bn (2028) and $78.5bn (2029).

items.title: Türkiye expected to climb in global tourism revenue rankings next year
items.summary: Budget documents project Türkiye moving from 7th to 6th in global tourism revenue in 2027 and 5th by 2028.

items.title: Antalya welcomes more than 15 million foreign tourists this year
items.summary: Antalya received 15.07m foreign visitors from 1 Jan to 27 Oct 2026, hosted the 77th International Astronautical Congress (18,000+ attendees) in October and is preparing for COP31.

items.title: Istanbul Hotel Market Shows Strong 2026 Occupancy Recovery as Can Erdem Highlights Positive Rebound
items.summary: STR's Can Erdem says Istanbul hotel occupancy recovered strongly from May–July 2026 after a weak H1, with healthy Sep–Oct bookings; Nov–Dec uncertain. No percentages given.

items.title: COP31 Pushes Antalya Hotel Rates to an Annual High
items.summary: Antalya standard-room rates average $268 in COP31's opening week and $239 in week two, 92% above the 2026 average and 119% above the same weeks of 2025; five-star inventory is priced 108% above annual average.

items.title: Turkey travel advice (FCDO) – updated 27 October 2026
items.summary: FCDO updated 'Warnings and insurance' with information on regional tensions, warning of possible flight cancellations and airspace closures; still advises against all travel within 10km of the Syria border.

items.title: Sağlık turizminde hasta sayısı düştü, kişi başı gelir arttı
items.summary: Türkiye recorded 563,327 health tourists in H1 2026 generating ~$1.58bn, fewer patients than H1 2025, while average spend per patient rose from ~$2,200 to ~$2,600.

items.title: Measles cases surge past 3,000 in Türkiye as vaccination coverage falls
items.summary: Measles cases in Türkiye near 3,000 in 2026 (from 127 in 2022) as MMR coverage drops to ~92%, below the 95% herd-immunity threshold. MEDICAL ANGLE: travel-vaccination advice must point to official sources/clinicians.

items.title: US measles surge reminds of Europe's vaccination gaps
items.summary: Lists Türkiye among 12 European countries where measles is endemic and warns of under-vaccinated pockets. MEDICAL ANGLE.

items.title: Dr. Serkan Aygin Announces Guide to Turkey's Top Hair Transplant Clinics
items.summary: Promotional press release by an Istanbul clinic listing 10 hair-transplant providers, itself first; not independent. MEDICAL/PROMOTIONAL – do not cite as evidence.

items.title: Türkiye outlines COP31 preparations for Antalya climate summit
items.summary: COP31 presidency has planned delegates' arrival-to-departure travel for the 9–20 November conference, with the leaders' summit on 11–12 November.

items.title: COP31 Launches Antalya Compact for Energy Efficient Buildings
items.summary: COP31 Presidency launched a framework on energy-efficient buildings for Parties to endorse (date seen on cop31.tr news listing).

items.title: Subsidized Youth Accommodation: Applications Now Open
items.summary: Subsidised room-and-breakfast (8–22 Nov) for delegates aged 18–35 from SIDS/LDCs, first-come first-served, applications closed 2 Nov 23:59 TRT. cop31.tr also says Green Zone needs free visitor registration and QR pass.

items.title: A Historic First in COP Sustainability
items.summary: COP31 says it obtained sustainability certifications before the conference began (date seen on listing).

items.title: Side Event Programme for the Türkiye Pavilion in Blue Zone has been announced
items.summary: Official announcement of the Türkiye Pavilion side-event programme in the COP31 Blue Zone (date seen on ministry news sidebar).

items.title: Türkiye deploys 630 low-emission buses for COP31
items.summary: 630 buses from 25 municipalities (71 electric, 233 CNG) will shuttle COP31 participants between hotels, airport, city centre and venue.

items.title: Türkiye expects 91 world leaders to attend COP31 in Antalya
items.summary: 91 heads of state/government confirmed; 196 countries, ~300 ministers and ~1.5m visitors expected for 9–20 November.

items.title: Antalya Valiliği duyurdu: COP31 zirvesi için trafik düzenlemeleri geliyor
items.summary: Traffic arrangements on 10–12 Nov: separate convoy lanes on the airport road, measures on ~18km of D-400 to Belek, full closure of 'Leaders' Road' on 11 Nov 07:30–12:00, EXPO2016 Boulevard shuttle-only.

items.title: Christodoulides: 'Of course I will attend COP31 summit in Turkey'
items.summary: Cyprus President confirmed on 13 Oct he will attend COP31 in Antalya (seen via a weekly bulletin; not opened).

items.title: Istanbul fair calendar sets window, door and glass showcase for November 2026
items.summary: Eurasia Window & Door Fair and Eurasia Glass Fair run 21–24 Nov 2026 at Tüyap Fair and Congress Center (organiser Reed Tüyap). Tüyap calendar also lists HOSTECH 10–14 Nov, Plast Eurasia 2–5 Dec, Istanbul Book Fair 12–20 Dec, Furniture Fair 19–23 Jan 2027.

items.title: 2027 Turizm Fuar Takvimi Açıklandı: İşte 16 Uluslararası Fuar ve Başvuru Şartları
items.summary: Türkiye Tourism Promotion and Development Agency (TGA) 2027 calendar of 16 international tourism fairs and participation conditions (date seen on listing; page fetch blocked).

items.title: ATRAX 2027 ne zaman? İstanbul'da 4 tematik alanla düzenlenecek
items.summary: ATRAX 2027 travel trade fair announced for Istanbul with four thematic areas (date seen on listing).

items.title: BST Turkey: Uluslararası Turizm Ticareti Karadeniz'in Kültürüyle Buluşuyor
items.summary: Coverage of BST Turkey, a new B2B tourism trade event held in Trabzon (date seen on listing).

items.title: 80 Milyar Dolarlık Turizm Ticaret Coğrafyasında Yeni Hamle: BST TURKEY
items.summary: Preview of BST Turkey 2026 B2B tourism meeting in Trabzon (date seen on listing).

items.title: Booking.com'a Sahte İlan ve Dolandırıcılık Soruşturması
items.summary: European Commission opened a DSA investigation into whether Booking.com protects users from fake listings and identity-theft scams, messaging security and ad labelling; fines up to 6% of turnover possible.

items.title: VFS Global'den Vize Randevusu Dolandırıcılığına Karşı Uyarı
items.summary: VFS Global warning about visa-appointment fraud (mainly relevant to residents applying for visas abroad; date seen on listing).

items.title: iDATA'dan Vize Randevuları Hakkında Kritik Açıklama: Aracılarla İş Birliğimiz Yok
items.summary: iDATA states it does not work with intermediaries for visa appointments (date seen on listing).

items.title: Tatil ve Tur Harcamalarında 18 Taksit İmkânı
items.summary: New rule allowing up to 18 credit-card instalments for holiday and tour spending (domestic consumers; date seen on listing).

items.title: Google'dan Seyahat Araştırması: Turistlerin Yalnızca Yüzde 8'i Rezervasyonu Yapay Zekâya Bırakıyor
items.summary: Google travel research: only 8% of tourists leave booking to AI (date seen on listing).

items.title: Dr. Tamer Çiçek'ten İstanbul'a Üçüncü Otel Yatırımı
items.summary: New hotel investment in Istanbul (date seen on listing).

items.title: Türkiye's annual inflation slows to 29.73% in September
items.summary: Annual CPI eased to 29.73% in September (monthly 1.84%); food, transport and housing contributed most.

items.title: Türkiye's October inflation expected at 2.2 percent
items.summary: AA Finans survey expects 2.2% monthly CPI in October (annual 29.28%); TÜİK publishes official data on 3 November.

items.title: Turkey Central Bank Cuts Rates to 36% as Oil Tests Easing Case
items.summary: CBRT cut the one-week repo rate to 36% on 22 Oct, ending five holds; energy inflation 46.11% and Brent at $117 cloud further easing.

items.title: Turkey lets lira fall quicker to avoid future devaluation risk
items.summary: Bloomberg reported the central bank is letting the lira weaken faster to avoid a sharper drop later (seen via weekly bulletin; paywalled, not opened).

items.title: Türkiye moves to revise data protection legislation in EU visa liberalization push
items.summary: Türkiye drafted data-protection reforms to meet one of six outstanding EU visa-liberalisation benchmarks; technical talks with the Commission expected.

items.title: Flooding brings İstanbul to a standstill as death toll rises
items.summary: Severe 14–15 Oct floods killed at least four; Istanbul Airport diverted 51 arrivals and cancelled 19 flights and officials urged avoiding unnecessary travel.

items.title: Istanbul reels from heaviest rainfall in over 80 years as floods kill two
items.summary: Heaviest rainfall since records began in 1942; schools closed, dozens of flights diverted, AFAD set up a crisis desk.

items.title: Istanbul Floods, October 2026
items.summary: Blog round-up of the 14–15 Oct floods: deaths, ~595 evacuations, flight diversions and transport disruption. Secondary source.

items.title: 5.2-Magnitude Earthquake Hits Southern Türkiye
items.summary: M5.2 quake centred in Sumbas plus aftershocks (4.4–4.9) in Saimbeyli, Adana; no casualties or damage reported.

items.title: Ticaret Bakanlığından yanıltıcı reklama 1 milyon 83 bin lira ceza
items.summary: Trade Ministry Advertising Board fined an e-commerce firm ~TRY1.08m for fake '80% discount' reference prices; shows consumer-protection enforcement, not tourism-specific.

items.title: Weekly News Bulletin on Turkey – October 19, 2026
items.summary: Weekly digest noting IMF raised Türkiye 2026 inflation forecast to 31.2% and cut growth to 2.7%, faster lira depreciation and COP31 attendance news.

items.title: Turkey Travel Advisory (US State Department) – Level 2
items.summary: OUT OF WINDOW (context): Level 2 'Exercise increased caution', Level 4 within 10km of Syria and Iraq borders; no update since 9 June.

items.title: ANFAŞ Food Product and Hotel Equipment Exhibitions to Take Place in Antalya in January 2027
items.summary: OUT OF WINDOW (context): 33rd ANFAŞ Food Product and 37th Hotel Equipment fairs run 12–15 Jan 2027 at ANFAŞ Expo Center, Antalya.

items.title: UK Warning Puts Turkey's Medical Tourism Pitch Under Fresh Scrutiny After Seven British Deaths
items.summary: OUT OF WINDOW (context): FCDO health page says it is aware of seven British nationals who died in Turkey in 2025 after medical procedures and advises consulting a UK clinician first. MEDICAL ANGLE.
